entities.summary: Caleb John Raleigh, nicknamed "Big Dumper", is an American professional baseball catcher for the Seattle Mariners of Major League Baseball (MLB). Raleigh is widely regarded as one of MLB's elite power hitters, all-around catchers, and switch hitters.
